title: An adaptive, space-time discretized linear iterative scheme for doubly-degenerate parabolic problems
summary: Degenerate diffusion problems, where the governing parabolic equation can change type to either an ordinary differential equation or an elliptic equation, model many real life applications. Due to the presence of free-boundaries, accurate numerical simulation of such problems require extremely small mesh and time step sizes locally. To remediate this issue, in this work, we consider a space-time formulation of the problem based on an efficient splitting of the nonlinearities.
